content.label: This app brings a lot of sonic therapy to my life. I love being able to select many different sonic landscapes and have them provide a soundtrack to whatever I’m doing at the moment. Other times I’ll focus on the app generators, and it’s like a sonic journey.
This.

title.label: only noise generator i’ve ever used

content.label: this is my absolute favorite app for noise, and i’ve been using it since 2015. i still have the legacy app, but i’ve got this one downloaded for whenever that stops working. i use it to sleep but i also use it to study and write. i love how many different sounds there are, and it’s so clear that this comes from such a passion and love for sound. i also love how much i can play around with all the sliders to create unique experiences. all that is great, but also having it ad-free? no forced subscription? truly i thank you for this gift ❤️

As a user of the legacy myNoise app, I wanted to share the app with one of my friends. I then found that the myNoise app had been completely re-designed and re-coded. Having used the old app built by Florian for several years, it’s a no-brainer to unlock the full access in the new version of the app. With this new app, I still have access to all the old generators that I loved, and will have access to everything new that comes out.

While there is a difference in the animations and I miss the multis, the new app is still a worthwhile upgrade - especially to ensure compatibility with future devices. 

P.S. The friend that I had download the new version of the myNoise app loves the fan sound. She says it’s the first noise app that has a realistic fan sound that she, an ADHD southerner, can use while traveling. With the right fiddling, it sounds just like a box fan :)
I have tried many different sound players but this is the only one to give true white noise,natural sounds and background playing.
i’m so surprised this isn’t more popular??? really really useful app with lots of helpful options and variety that mixes up the droning ambience you can find everywhere. really high quality app.
The sounds are great. Customization is great. App crashes if used long term.

MyNoise is something special. The sounds are high quality and customizable to create the perfect backdrop for sleeping, working, meditation, art, writing, reading, and etc. The multiple layers add richness and depth so that I feel transported into the sound environment. They are wonderful to use as background, but also really enjoyable to focus on directly as well! There are so many details to notice in each soundscape. Thank you!

I’ve used this website daily for a while now. So glad they’ve made an app for it. It has so much more than just white noise. If you’re reading this review, give this app a chance and make a purchase to get the full library. You will not regret it.

I’ve been enjoying (and contributing to) myNoise on desktop and the old app for many years. The creators of myNoise are passionate about the project and go to great lengths to gather new and interesting soundscapes from all around the world. They have a fair monetization strategy and deserve your support.

I love the myNoise app, I have used it for years whether to help me fall back asleep at night, or as background sound in the office to help me focus. I have recommended it to everybody in search of some relaxation or better sleep. 
Now I was saddened to hear that a code developer left, we can’t update the old one, where I had unlimited locked; and we have to switch from the old app to the new app … so I don’t know if there will be an account transfer. But, anyway. This is the best background noise app I have found. Very high quality. Customizable sound scapes.

title.label: all the things you left in your version but didn't include in ours

content.label:
layering go? whitenoise atop binaural, this is a drug in its own right. prior versions allowed at least four layers, 

 and custom slider movement behavior? (zen, subtle, moderate, allegro, wobbler; all had distinct and specific uses, taught me to meditate, anyone deserves access to this)

variable fadeout duration for the timer was also loved, five minute fadeout as a gentle indicator of when, by simply noticing the sound's departure

we are not so stupid as to pay for returning features from legacy versions

        these made the app useful ♡, 

at the very least mixing binaural and whitenoise returning, useful for all sort

  sculpting for utility ❍☯︎•

So glad to see the best collection around getting an app to properly showcase it. After trying other apps that had a play together option but a poor sound quality/quantity, finding this new app with the same functionality but so much more quality was just what I wanted.

I’ve long appreciated the website and I’m so excited for this app!  Thank you so much for all the time and effort you’ve devoted to this amazing collection - my tinnitus-plagued ears truly appreciate it!

I came from the desktop website which I already love and wow, this app! Oh my gosh. It's simultaneously comforting to explore and fascinating to peruse and life affirming! But most of all, it is a treat for the ears. Love it. Thanks!

I have used the old app and the website for years. They have wonderful high-quality sounds that you can tune easily to your needs. The owner is very friendly and always adding new stuff.

This looks like a nice upgrade and I'm happy to see it *except* that it's missing multi-gens. I almost never listen to a single sound alone - all of my favorites are multis. So unfortunately I will have to stick with the old app, unless that feature is added.

title.label: Favorite factory sounds are no longer available

content.label: Old app was better by far. They’ve cut or partitioned my favorite sounds!

I’ve been a myNoise user for over a decade. This new mobile app is amazing. It’s the incredible website in the palm of my hand. Sound quality is excellent. Worth every penny!! Even the free version is solid.

I’ve been a user of myNoise since it was only available as a website. Absolutely best soundscapes out there. The quality and breadth of sounds is truly amazing and the updates over the years continue to delight me. I also appreciate the one time purchase model.

title.label: I miss the old ios version

content.label: I was an avid user of this app before changing it. I love how I could combine my sounds and play in the background. I also purchased the full version prior and no longer have the same access. Idk why there was such a drastic change but now I need a new app for my brainwave entertainment.

title.label: Makes my life a little better

content.label: I’ve been a user, first of the website, then the old app and now the new app. MyNoise is one of the first things that goes on any phone or laptop of mine. It just makes everything better. I work with it in the background and when I fly, it’s playing on my headphones. I’ve recommended this to everyone I know. And Stephane seems like a truly good person which probably explains a lot about why this app is great. Thank you for making my everyday life just a little bit better.

title.label: I loved the original version of the ios app

content.label: This app and website has been helpful for me for years but since this newer version for ios came out I lost the premium that I had already purchased in the past because there's no login option in the app. Unfortunately I also haven't been able to combine different sound packs the way you could in the previous versions, for example mixing a chior of singing bowls with thunderstorms. If these are just bugs that are being worked out then I'm very excited to get back to being able to mix my sounds to meet my needs, if not I hope they change their minds about taking away those features. Still a very good app and website though.

title.label: the Only Sound App I Can Focus With

content.label:
I work from home and am easily distracted.  My mind races and I find it difficult to focus on work.

MyNoise has completely changed that for me and I could not be more thankful to them.  The sounds are high quality, the app is stylish and easy to navigate, and there’s continuous, uninterrupted playback with no ads.  With a pair of ANC headphones I can focus for hours and be productive!

Although all of the sounds are top notch, if you’re a space junky like me you will be amazed at the different sounds MyNoise offers.  War Speed is my current favorite but Saturn Rings are a close 2nd.

I genuinely feel like no matter what your preference in sound is, there’s something for everyone.

Also if you ever have to contact the team, you can expect a prompt and friendly response like I received after entering the wrong email when I signed up 😅

From the bottom of my heart, thank you to this team and the wonderful work you do!
The new app looks great! I’m only an occasional user of the website and old app, but when I need it, I NEED it. Happy patron for years now and I don’t know where I’d be without myNoise!

So happy to see the app has been refreshed as I use it every night to go to sleep and all throughout the day when tinnitus is at its worst. 

The app has some polish items to take care of, but I trust Rémy will be diligent and address each over time. It's hard building an app with a small team and limited resources.

After all: no subscription fee here... just a one-time purchase, which is one of many reasons I give it 5 stars.

Been a myNoise supporter for many years now--some of the sounds were even recorded by me. Looking forward to a lifetime of supporting these fine folks in Belgium. Thank you Stéphane and Rémy (and developer!) for all your hard work.

I am very disappointed by removal of the original app from AppStore and I will never pay your subscription ever again.
myNoise is finally reaching platform degradation stage, and it breaks my heart

title.label: Awesome app by an awesome team

content.label: I’ve been a user of the myNoise website for years, and have always appreciated the quality content that they have provided. Once again, they’ve output another great piece of work 👍 thank you myNoise.
